listing.title: Breathtaking Malibu Ocean View Sanctuary
listing.description:
Experience panoramic ocean and canyon views at this one-of-a-kind Malibu home, overlooking one of the most pristine canyons in Malibu.

This stunning 3 BD / 3.5 BA home was recently renovated into a modern sanctuary to reset in nature while staying close to the coast. The architecture frames sunrise, marine layer, and sunset with the kind of calm that makes you slow down immediately.

Furniture may differ slightly from older photos, but the overall atmosphere remains a warm modern retreat with strong indoor-outdoor flow.

photos.alt: Main living room with glass walls and ocean view
Warm-toned sitting area with canyon light
Bedroom with sliding doors to the deck
Kitchen and dining area framed by large windows

highlights.description: Guests consistently call out the canyon light and coastal panorama.

reviews.name: Jessy
reviews.body: Thanks so much for a lovely visit. We so enjoyed the gorgeous view, the fire pit at sunset and the great views from inside too.

reviews.name: Calvin
reviews.body: Incredible views. Really pleasant and helpful owner. The house is something out of the ordinary, stepping down from the cliff with cozy balconies.

cancellation_items: Cancel before check-in on March 18 for a partial refund.

products.subtitle: Men's Shoes

nike-pdp.title: Nike Alphafly 3
nike-pdp.subtitle: Men's Road Racing Shoes
nike-pdp.description: Fine-tuned for marathon speed, the Alphafly 3 helps you push beyond what you thought possible with three innovative technologies. A double dose of Air Zoom units works with a full-length carbon fiber plate to help launch you into your next step. The ZoomX foam midsole helps keep you fresh from mile 1 to 26.2. Time to leave your old personal records in the dust.
nike-pdp.reason_to_buy: Pinnacle tech creates a propulsive ride fine-tuned for marathon speed.

benefits.title: Propulsive Air Zoom Units
benefits.description: Two Zoom Air units in the forefoot store and return energy back to you, helping power your every step.

benefits.title: ZoomX Foam Cushioning
benefits.description: The ultralight ZoomX foam midsole is fully connected to the outsole, providing you with a smooth transition and optimized responsiveness throughout your race.

benefits.title: Full-Length Carbon Fiber Plate
benefits.description: A slightly wider carbon fiber Flyplate gives you a propulsive and stable feel with each step and turn.

whats_new: Wider carbon fiber plate for increased stability
Fully connected ZoomX foam midsole for smoother transitions
Notched laces offer a secure but soft lace-up
Integrated knit tongue with lofted padding helps alleviate lace pressure

reviews.author: Maxi
reviews.title: Great fast shoes!
reviews.body: Such a good shoe, especially if you can find it discounted. It's not very pleasant at slow paces, but as soon as you pick up the pace (marathon pace and faster), it feels extremely good.

reviews.author: todd342037895
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!
reviews.body: A well deserved 5 out of 5 stars for the Alphafly 3. They perform incredibly well for different types of runs on a multitude of surfaces and terrain. The best fitting shoes I have ever worn.

reviews.author: KOV81
reviews.title: Great Shoe, Great Performance
reviews.body: Purchased two weeks ago. Very Satisfied, Great Performance, Adds Speed and comfort to run.

reviews.author: RunnerX
reviews.title: Questionable durability
reviews.body: Great shoe, but after 100 miles, I have lost part of the bottom of the shoe. Not sure I can run in it anymore.

reviews.author: VanceMan
reviews.title: Vance Man Approves
reviews.body: Love mine! Best running shoes I've ever owned. The carbon fiber plate makes a huge difference.

reviews.author: MarathonMike
reviews.title: Best running shoes yet
reviews.body: These are the best running shoes I've ever worn. The cushioning is incredible and the energy return is noticeable.

reviews.author: SpeedDemon
reviews.title: Great shoes for running
reviews.body: Excellent for tempo runs and race day. Very lightweight and responsive.

reviews.author: TrackStar
reviews.title: Great Racing Shoes!
reviews.body: Perfect for marathon racing. The Air Zoom units provide incredible bounce.

reviews.author: JoggerJoe
reviews.title: Light and responsive
reviews.body: These shoes are incredibly light. You can feel the carbon fiber plate working with every stride.

reviews.author: PaceSetter
reviews.title: Real good
reviews.body: Solid shoe. Great for fast-paced runs. Highly recommend for serious runners.
